articles.body_text: Belöningen erbjuds via det amerikanska utrikesdepartementet. Arkivbild. USA: 20 miljoner dollar för information om Iran USA utlovar upp till 20 miljoner dollar i belöning för information om Irans kärnenergiprogram, uppger militärkommandot Centcom. Uppgifter om anläggningar, utrustning och personal kopplade till kärnenergiprogrammet tycks kunna få den amerikanska staten att lätta på plånboken. För rätt information erbjuds uppemot 20 miljoner dollar – cirka 200 miljoner kronor – samt en eventuell ”omplacering” för uppgiftslämnaren, skriver Centcom på X . Det amerikanska utrikesdepartementet har sedan 1980-talet erbjudit pengar för information via programmet Rewards for Justice, vilket uppges användas även i det här fallet.

articles.title: Paraguays president avsatt – kan åtalas
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Paraguays president avsatt – kan åtalas
articles.body_text: Santiago Peña skrev i torsdags under den avskedsansökan som på fredagen avvisades av landets senat. Paraguays senat har röstat för att avsätta president Santiago Peña till följd av misskötsel. Beslutet innebär att Peña kan komma att åtalas till följd av den bankkris som drabbat landet. Genom att avsätta Peña i stället för att acceptera den avskedsansökan som han lämnat in fråntas Peña möjligheten till en livslång plats i senaten och den immunitet som han annars enligt lag hade åtnjutit. Krisen utlöstes i samband med att banken Ueno – där ungefär 60 procent av landets vuxna är kunder – kollapsat, vilket skickade chockvågor genom landets finansiella system. Peña har tidigare varit delägare i den koncern som kontrollerar banken. Åklagare har inlett en utredning om Ueno-kraschen, där bland andra Peña är föremål för granskning. Enligt åklagare har Peña nu satts i husarrest. Vicepresidenten Pedro Alliana har svurits in som ny president.

articles.title: Spansk olivolja hålls tillbaka mot prisras
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Spansk olivolja hålls tillbaka mot prisras
articles.body_text: Spansk olivolja hålls tillbaka mot prisras För att stoppa ett kraftigt prisfall beordrar Spanien landets olivoljefabriker att hålla inne 12 procent av sin produktion, rapporterar Bloomberg. Beslutet, som presenterades av jordbruksminister Luis Planas Puchades under fredagen, innebär att cirka 188 000 ton olivolja tas bort från marknaden. Enligt EU:s och Spaniens bestämmelser kan sådana åtgärder tillåtas om det totala utbudet överstiger 120 procent av genomsnittet från de sex senaste säsongerna. Den stora skörden tillsammans med befintliga lager pressade priserna på extra jungfruolja till ett femårslägsta i slutet av oktober. Efter två år med svår torka, 2022 och 2023, har gynnsamt väder med mycket regn lett till ett kraftigt uppsving. Årets produktion beräknas öka med 23 procent till 1,6 miljoner ton – den fjärde största skörden någonsin i landet. Spanien står för en tredjedel av världens olivoljeproduktion.

articles.title: De gör upp om att bli ny ECB-chef
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: De gör upp om att bli ny ECB-chef
articles.body_text: Europeiska centralbankens kontor under en dimmig dag i Frankfurt. Arkivbild. Två kandidater har kastat in hatten i ringen för att efterträda Christine Lagarde som chef för Europeiska centralbanken ECB. Det är spanjoren Pablo Hernández de Cos och nederländaren Klaas Kno, som anmält sig till posten, meddelar eurogruppen i ett pressmeddelande . De är båda tidigare chefer för sina respektive länders centralbanker. Hernández de Cos är också sittande chef för centralbankernas egen bank, BIS. Förhoppningen är att ett beslut om vem som ersätter Lagarde, som avgår i förtid den 7 februari 2027, kan fattas i mitten av december, uppger en källa för nyhetsbyrån AFP.

articles.title: Teknikaktier studsade upp efter AI-raset
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Teknikaktier studsade upp efter AI-raset
articles.body_text: Teknikaktier studsade upp efter AI-raset Teknikaktier återhämtar sig något efter torsdagens börsras i USA. Men AI-oron finns kvar på marknaden, säger Nordeas aktiestrateg Martin Björsell till TT. Nasdaqs tekniktunga kompositindex hade studsat upp 1,7 procent drygt 30 minuter in i den tidiga fredagshandeln i New York, efter torsdagens ras på 5,5 procent. Vi får en liten återhämtning och den är ganska välbehövlig. Hade vi inte sett det tycker jag att man hade kunnat vara mer oroad, säger Björsell. Dow Jones industriindex var samtidigt ned 0,3 procent, medan breda S&P 500 pekade upp 0,9 procent. AI-bjässen Nvidia, vars aktie rasade 9 procent i torsdags, handlades upp 6,3 procent. Konkurrenten Advanced Micro Devices var upp 12,3 procent, efter gårdagens ras på 17,3 procent. Rörelsen i går kändes som att den var accelererande och på det sättet blev den lite mer som en panikrörelse. Därför hade man hoppats på att det skulle få en liten moteffekt i dag, säger Björsell. Torsdagens börsras i USA, det värsta sedan april 2025, kopplas ihop med oro för bakslag för AI-sektorn efter Demokratiska partiets framgångar i mellanårsvalet tidigare i veckan. Nedgången var framför allt driven av oro för AI och datacenterinvesteringar, sen fick det betydligt bredare effekt just i går. Björsell tror att det kommer vara volatilt på börserna även nästa vecka. Jag tror att man ska vara beredd på att marknaden kommer vara än mer nervös och jag tror att huvudfokus borde vara kring AI och hur man ska se på framtida investeringar.

articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Hur fungerar den publicistiska grunden för nyhets- och samhällsjournalistik på TV4?
articles.body_text: Hur fungerar den publicistiska grunden för nyhets- och samhällsjournalistik på TV4? 9 januari 2024 ・ Uppdaterad: 15 augusti 2025 TV4:s nyhets- och samhällsbevakning ska vara i ögonhöjd med tittarna. Vi vill vara nära, personliga och inkluderande. För alla i hela Sverige. Vi ska vara trovärdiga och relevanta. Vi testar nya visuella former och utvecklar det rörliga berättandet. Vi är både snabba, och fördjupande. Vi ger plats för både humor och allvar. Vi påverkar och berör. Vi avslöjar maktmissbruk, och värnar pressfrihet och yttrandefrihet. Vi producerar Nyhetsmorgon, Nyhetsdagen, Efter fem och kvällsnyheter. Vi nyhetsrapporterar på tv4.se och fördjupar i kortdokumentärerna Nyheterna Story. Vår mångfaldigt prisbelönta redaktion Kalla Fakta granskar makt och missförhållanden. TV4:s nyhets- och samhällsbevakning sker ur ett riksperspektiv, med hela Sverige och världen som bevakningsområde. Vi har 17 rikskorrar på sex orter i Sverige. De finns i Luleå, Umeå, Östersund, Skövde, Göteborg och Malmö. Vi bevakar världen via utrikesreportrar, korrar och stringers. Vår journalistik vilar på respekt för alla människors lika värde, oavsett politisk åskådning, religion eller sexuell läggning. Det innebär att vi låter många röster komma till tals, även de som bär åsikter som inte nödvändigtvis delas av medarbetarna på redaktionen eller TV4. Men det kan också innebära att vi tar bort artikelkommentarer som kränker, eller till exempel avstår gäster i direktsändning där vi bedömer att risken är stor för missbruk av öppenheten. TV4:s nyhets- och samhällsjournalistik är oberoende och obunden. Den står fri från politiska partier, organisationer, och näringsliv. Vi har ingen ledarsida eller politisk färg. Innehållet på våra plattformar bedöms och värderas av redaktörer, producenter och av ansvarig utgivare före publicering. Vi följer grundlagen och skyddar våra källor när de önskar anonymitet. Om vi refererar uppgifter från andra medier redovisar vi vilka medier eller andra informationskällor det handlar om. Annars berättar vi hur vi själva tagit reda på informationen, dock alltid med största respekt för källskydd.

articles.title: Bortglömda fiskar
articles.summary: Teatrar och konserthus lockar allt oftare med olika sidoevenemang. Teater Västernorrland har musikquiz, Folkoperan sänder poddar från sin foajé och på Göteborgsoperan kan man höra föredrag eller vara med och dansa. De uppsluppna tillställningarna, före och efter konserter och föreställningar, lockar också en ny sorts publik. En av Östersjöfestivalens mest omtalade programpunkter, förutom musiken i Berwaldhallen, har varit “Bortglömda fiskar” - en oväntad kulinarisk träff med Kålrotsakademin och provsmakning av “svensk sushi”. “Gensvaret från publiken är enormt. Man vill bli överraskad”, konstaterar Emma Nyberg, exekutiv producent på Berwaldhallen. Och på frågan om vad nors och näbbgädda har att göra i ett konserthus kommer det självklara svaret snabbt: “Att äta gott och att lyssna på klassisk musik hör ihop, båda skärper och öppnar våra sinnen.”

articles.title: Spain's rail authorities face European fraud probe after Urda rail disaster
articles.summary: Prosecutors begin investigating EU funds meant for upgrading the Spanish railway line where a train crash killed 69 people.
articles.body_text: European Union prosecutors have begun investigating the possible misuse of EU funds meant for upgrading the Spanish railway line where a train crash killed 69 people last week. Prosecutors backed by a special unit of Spain's Guardia Civil security force said they were conducting the inquiry at the offices of Adif rail infrastructure authority and rail safety agency AESF. The 28 October accident on the Madrid-Seville high-speed line was one of the worst railway disasters in Europe this century. It is the second EU fraud inquiry opened into Spain's railways this year, after 46 people were killed on the same line at Adamuz in January. Last week, a train operated by state-owned operator Renfe ploughed into the back of a stationary train belonging to private Spanish company Iryo outside the village of Urda, around 130km (80 miles) south of Madrid. The LZB communication system that monitors the position of trains had gone down, and the Renfe train had been given the all clear to start running at normal speed, even though the Iryo train ahead of it had been unable to restart. The two accidents nine months apart on the same line have claimed 115 lives and dozens more injuries. The European Public Prosecutor's Office (EPPO) said on Friday it had begun conducting investigative measures at Spain's rail authorities "after the opening of an investigation into possible fraud affecting EU funds allocated to the renovation and upgrading of safety, signalling and communications systems on the Madrid-Seville high-speed railway line". The EPPO highlighted high public interest in the case, but said no further details would be made public. As part of the process, a Spanish judge assigned to the case has to ensure the investigation complies with legal safeguards, including authorising any measures that might involve house searches or phone-tapping. The Urda disaster has damaged the Socialist-led government of Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez ahead of a 29 November general election and the party is trailing the conservative People's Party (PP) in most opinion polls. Close Sánchez ally Óscar Puente resigned this week as transport minister, after seeing two deadly accidents on his watch this year.

articles.title: Dozens of Democrats eyeing 2028 presidential run, says former Obama aide
articles.summary: Jim Messina tells the BBC that after Democrats' midterm victories he's talked to "over two dozen campaigns", with some already hiring staff.
articles.body_text: More than two dozen Democrats are eyeing runs for the White House in 2028, following their party's success in the US midterm elections this week, according to the man behind Barack Obama's successful re-election bid. Jim Messina, who led Obama's 2012 campaign, said that since Democrats saw major victories in congressional races as well as state elections, he's spoken to "over two dozen campaigns" that are actively considering running in 2028 and have begun the financing process and hiring staff. "I think you're going to start having Democrats announce exploratory committees next week or the next couple of weeks, probably after Thanksgiving", Messina told the BBC's Americast podcast. He said he already knows someone relocating to work on a governor's presidential campaign. He also predicted that the number could shrink as candidates faced pressure to raise large sums needed for the primary contests that will decide the party's nominee. Messina gave some insight into the conversations he's had, saying: "When I sit down with candidates or their campaigns, I say to them, 'Tell me your economic vision for the future of this country. What are you going to do on AI?'" Then there's another factor: the outgoing president, Donald Trump, who will still be in office during the campaign season. "And so, do the Democrats take the bait and talk about Donald Trump every day, or do you stay focused on your message?" he said. "It's going be the most interesting presidential [election] since 2008." Messina, who went on to become Obama's deputy chief of staff at the White House, said the party's success in the US midterm elections was down to their ability to stay focused on the economy and the effect of Donald Trump's tariffs, which were "devastating to rural voters". "When you're a farmer and you're paying $7 for a gallon of diesel to put in your tractor, the economics just don't work, and at the same time you're paying more for everything," he said. Staying on message about the economy helped them flip seats in traditionally strong Republican states like Iowa, Kansas, and Texas, he said.

articles.title: Four midterms takeaways for 2028 White House race
articles.summary: The buzz about the presidential election is already under way - here's what we learned this week.
articles.body_text: Ballots are still being counted in the US midterm elections but the political landscape is already pivoting to the 2028 White House race. Buoyed by major gains in Congress, Democrats will have momentum as they prepare for the contest to succeed President Donald Trump. But a good showing in the midterms does not guarantee a White House win two years later. Barack Obama was re-elected in 2012 despite huge Republican gains in 2010. No one has yet entered the presidential race but potential candidates will be preparing behind the scenes. Vice-President's JD Vance's reflection on where the midterms went wrong for Republicans has been interpreted as him paving the way for a 2028 run. The results of Tuesday's election and the historic size of Democratic gains could shape the White House race in several ways. Here are four takeaways. Several prominent potential presidential candidates were running in the 2026 midterms - and some emerged looking strong. Georgia Democratic Senator Jon Ossoff won by a sizeable margin in the politically competitive state that Trump won in 2024. While he has previously said he has no plans to run for president, his successful campaign, with several viral moments, helped boost his national profile. Another potential Democratic nominee, Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro , swept aside his Republican challenger. Shapiro has not committed to a 2028 run but analysts point to his broad appeal in swing-state Pennsylvania as a sign that he could be competitive on the national stage. Illinois Governor JB Pritzker also won after a campaign pundits in his state described as a "tune-up" for a presidential run.

articles.title: New wave of bomb threats hit European airlines
articles.summary: No link has been established between the threats against the airlines and those against the media outlets.
articles.body_text: European airlines have again been hit with a new wave of bomb threats - in the third such incident this week. On Friday multiple flights to and from Lisbon, Rome, Prague and Sofia were targeted and the threats saw three planes escorted by Hungarian fighter jets, authorities said. It also saw a number of high-profile media organisations, including Ireland's public broadcaster RTÉ , evacuated after threats were made against them - although there has been no concrete links between the messages against airlines and the broadcasters. The disruption comes after nearly 30 aircraft and several airports across Europe were impacted by threats earlier this week , in what the UK called a "malicious hoax". A Ryanair flight scheduled to leave Lisbon for Rome on Friday was targeted with a threat, the airline said, while at least 11 flights were targeted in the Czech Republic and Bulgaria, according to AFP. France also reported at least four of its flights were targeted by threats, however they all landed safely. No explosives have been found on any planes as of Friday. As airlines were dealing with this latest wave of threats, several media outlets, including RTÉ, were evacuated after similar warnings were made against them. Staff at the Irish Independent newspaper and the Dublin offices of radio stations NewstalkFM and TodayFM, were also advised to leave their buildings and UK broadcaster Sky said it also received a security threat. In a statement, gardaí (Irish police) said they were "aware of a threat made against media organisations here and in Europe". While no link has been established between the threats against airlines and media outlets, the Irish government has warned it is a "likely coordinated campaign of disruption". In a statement, it said: "Hoax threats such as these cause fear, distress and disruption to people going about their daily lives and activities; they achieve no positive purpose whatsoever. It is not known yet who is responsible for these threats, whether it is individuals or a centralised or co-ordinated effort.

articles.title: AI stocks bounce back after trillions wiped from market values
articles.summary: Investors had been selling off tech shares in part due to concerns the Democrat election victory would mean slower AI development.
articles.body_text: Shares in artificial intelligence and technology firms have recovered slightly from an enormous sell-off that wiped trillions of dollars off stock values. The tech-heavy Nasdaq stock index closed in positive territory following a market rout that began in the US on Thursday before spilling over to Asian and European markets into Friday. Investors had been selling off tech shares in part due to concerns the Democrat victory in the midterm elections would mean slower artificial intelligence development. However the latest US employment figures added to a mixed picture for American markets on Friday morning, with an unexpectedly strong 165,000 jobs added to the economy in September. On Thursday, businesses closely linked to artificial intelligence development took a hammering on stock markets, particularly chip and semiconductor makers. But the Nasdaq Composite bounced back slightly on Friday, ending the day up 1.1%, partly reversing some of its 5.5% fall. The S&P 500, which tracks the share prices of the largest publicly-traded US companies, closed up 0.3%, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average was flat through the day before ending slightly down 0.4%. Companies that lost hundreds of billions in market value recovered some ground on Friday, including Nvidia, SpaceX and Tesla. However, stock markets in Asia and Europe fared worse. The Kospi in South Korea closed down 6% on Friday, with shares in chipmaker SK Hynix plunging more than 10%. European markets also fell, with the main indexes in Germany, France and Spain ending the day down. In the UK, the FTSE 100, which tracks the largest companies on the London Stock Exchange, declined 1.01%. In addition to the recent market volatility, UK traders were also digesting the latest Bank of England decision to raise interest rates and the signal that another rate rise could be on the cards to curb rising prices.

articles.title: Is it the end of the road for Tesla's Cybertruck?
articles.summary: The car company's CEO Elon Musk has said production will halt in Texas, to focus on the firm's self-driving Cybercabs.
articles.body_text: Tesla CEO Elon Musk has said production of the firm's Cybertruck is "winding down" in Texas, to focus on its self-driving Cybercab cars. The model is only produced at Tesla's Austin base, and he did not clarify if manufacturing would be moved elsewhere or simply cease. The Cybertruck has received a mixed response since its launch in 2023, with some praising its individuality and others simply labelling it ugly. It has also suffered from disappointing sales, quality problems and recalls. BBC technology reporter Shiona McCallum has this report. The BBC's technology correspondent Joe Tidy explains how it happened, and what it means for you. Social media giant Meta is on trial over claims it deliberately designed its platforms to be addictive to young people. The prime minister announced that under-16s will be banned from social media by spring 2027. The BBC's Vanessa Clarke talks through the government's new advice for children using screens. Some major retailers and independent stores have introduced AI body scans, CCTV or facial recognition equipment to identify crimes like shoplifting. The BBC's Asia business correspondent says it is still unclear what sort of experience TikTok users in the US will get. Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 has been named game of the year at this year's Game Awards.

articles.title: Russian extremist group denies sending hoax bomb threats
articles.summary: Scores of flights across Europe have received bomb threats this week, but no explosives have been found so far.
articles.body_text: The "Male State", an extremist misogynistic group named in this week's hoax bomb threats to Italian airports, has denied any link to the false warnings causing flight disruption across Europe . The comments to the BBC came as reports of more bomb scares to airlines began appearing, including on a Ryanair flight from Rome to Lisbon and a Wizz Air flight from Prague to Rome which was diverted to Venice. Bomb threats were also reported to a number of high-profile Irish media organisations on Friday, prompting evacuations and a statement from the Irish government suggesting a "co-ordinated campaign of disruption". Replying to the BBC Russian Service, an account on Telegram - one of several linked to the so-called "Male State" and its founder Vladislav Pozdnyakov - mocked any suggestion the group was involved in emailing the threats. "What Male State? Where have you seen it? It hasn't existed for many years," the message on the channel reads. "If tomorrow they sign a [threat] letter, say, from Putin, will you then try to reach our president to ask your stupid question?" The group was banned in Russia in 2021 and Pozdnyakov is now thought to live abroad. It has since renamed itself in some places as "Male Legion". The initial hoax email, seen by the BBC, was sent on Thursday at 07:21 with the subject title: warning of a threat. It was addressed to several offices and individuals at Aeroporti di Roma (ADR), the airport managing company in Rome, as well as accounts at the city's Fiumicino airport itself. The originating email address seems to be linked to the state health services in Bogota, Colombia. It's not clear whether other countries' airports or airlines received the same or similar threat. At least one warning made on Friday appears to have come by phone, not email. Written in word perfect Italian, the bizarre text sent to Rome on Thursday claimed that "fighters" of the "Male State" had planted explosives on two incoming flights in an attack on Italy's "feminist regime" that would be "remembered forever". One flight was diverted as a result - ordered to land in France – another was escorted into Rome by Italian air force jets, scrambled for the second time this week. No explosives were found on either plane, or any other that reported receiving bomb threats. Asked why this particular email was taken so seriously, a source at ADR in Rome told the BBC that such warnings were extremely unusual. They didn't remember anything similar in recent years.

articles.title: Tundu Lissu: Tanzania opposition leader found guilty of incitement but acquitted of treason
articles.summary: The 58-year-old, who has been detained since April last year, says the charges are politically motivated.
articles.body_text: Tanzania's main opposition leader, Tundu Lissu, has been found guilty of inciting unrest and sentenced to four years in jail, in a case that has raised concerns about political freedom in the East African country. A panel of three judges at the High Court in Dar es Salaam acquitted him of the more serious offence of treason, saying prosecutors had failed to prove a key element of that charge. But they said the 58-year-old, who has been detained since April last year, had encouraged his supporters to disrupt the disputed 2025 general election. Lissu, who leads the opposition Chadema party, has denied the charges, describing the prosecution as politically motivated. The court said his campaign slogan "No Reforms, No Election" was sufficient for him to be convicted of the charge of incitement. "By uttering those words with the intention of disseminating them to the public, the accused incited the public to disrupt the 2025 elections," the court ruled. Lissu said he had only been charged with treason, not incitement. "The offence of incitement is one that you, honourable judges, have manufactured. You have created an offence that did not exist, and you have done so on political directives," Lissu told the court. He added that he would like to apply for bail as this was possible for incitement, unlike treason. He has leave to appeal at the Court of Appeal - the country's highest court. But if the four-year sentence is upheld, it would rule him out of the next elections, due in 2030. Treason is among Tanzania's most serious offences and can carry the death penalty.

articles.title: Two dead after bus crashes in France, officials say
articles.summary: One child and one young adult were killed in the crash, local authorities say, with more injured.
articles.body_text: A young girl and an 18-year-old man have died after a bus crashed in eastern France, local authorities have said. The bus was travelling between Lyon and Bourg-en-Bresse when it crashed at around 07:00 local time on Friday in the town of Lent. The bus was carrying 43 passengers, including 15 children, the Bourg-en-Bresse prosecutor's office said. Three people are in a critical condition and at least 13 others have sustained minor injuries. French President Emmanuel Macron said his thoughts were with the victims, the injured, and their families. In a post on X, he said the nation stood by their side and thanked the rescue teams involved. The town's mayor Yves Cristin told French media the bus "left the road and hit a tree in the ditch". The two people killed have been identified by authorities. However, there have been differing reports as to the age of the girl. The prosecutor's office said it was "opening an investigation into the incident, on charges of road homicide and aggravated road traffic injuries". The driver has been taken to hospital after sustaining injuries and has not yet been questioned by police. French Transport Minister Philippe Tabarot said initial tests indicated there were no traces of alcohol or drugs in his blood. Photos circulating in French media show a blue and white bus tilted in what appears to be a ditch on the roadside. Trees line the side of the road. The front of the bus appears to be heavily damaged. Local mayor Cristin told BFM TV: "I arrived minutes after the accident and people were in shock. "The side of the bus was torn off, and clearly, the people who were on that side must have been seriously injured."

articles.title: Paul Mackenzie: Kenya doomsday cult leader sentenced to 200 years in prison for Shakahola deaths
articles.summary: Paul Mackenzie ordered his followers to starve their children to death in a forest so they could "meet Jesus".
articles.body_text: A Kenyan court has sentenced the leader of a doomsday cult, Paul Mackenzie, to 200 years in prison for murdering 191 people, all but one of them children. Alongside 28 others, Mackenzie was found guilty of the murders for instructing members of his cult to starve their children to death so they could "meet Jesus". Justice Diana Mochache said Mackenzie bore the "primary criminal culpability" for ordering his followers to fast to death, in one of the world's deadliest episodes of cult activity. "The sentence is appropriate and just, to send an unmistakable message that such atrocities warrant the maximum penalties allowed by law," the judge added. The self-styled pastor was arrested in 2023 after the discovery of more than 400 bodies in shallow graves in Shakahola forest near the Kenyan coast. The sprawling investigation into the cases shocked Kenya and drew international attention. The court sentenced Mackenzie to 100 years in prison for homicide and another 100 years for offences related to starvation. The sentences within each category will run concurrently, but the two sets will run consecutively, bringing his total prison term to 200 years. Mackenzie also faces separate manslaughter and terrorism charges, which he denies. Prosecutors had sought the death penalty, arguing that the scale and circumstances of the killings warranted the harshest punishment. However, Justice Mochache declined to impose the death penalty, despite ruling that the case met the threshold for its consideration. "Nevertheless, the court declines the invitation to impose the death penalty on any of the victims," she said, adding that capital punishment would eliminate any prospect of rehabilitation and disengagement. The death sentence has not been carried out in Kenya since 1987. Mackenzie was tried alongside 28 accomplices, including guards who enforced his fasting orders and gravediggers who helped conceal the victims' bodies in mass graves.

articles.title: Judge blocks construction of Donald Trump's massive arch
articles.summary: The Trump administration had hoped the construction of the 250-foot arch could begin as early as this week.
articles.body_text: A federal judge has temporarily blocked construction of US President Donald Trump's "triumphal arch" in the nation's capital. US District Judge Tanya Chutkan ruled that there should be a 14-day pause before any work can start on the arch in Washington which the Trump administration had said could begin this week. Earlier on Thursday the National Capital Planning Commission (NCPC) voted 8-4 to allow construction of the planned 250ft (72m) arch. Trump appointees on the board said the arch would be a fitting tribute to US history and to veterans but opponents have argued it would block the view of Arlington National Cemetery, the resting place of thousands of US soldiers and service people. The so-called Arc de Trump - a play on the name of the famous arch in Paris, the Arc de Triomphe - is one of the president's efforts to remake the capital city in his style and is meant to commemorate the country's 250th anniversary. The approval on Thursday evening came after nearly nine hours of public comment. "The White House commends the National Capital Planning Commission's decision to fully approve President Trump's historic vision to build a much needed Triumphal Arch in Washington, DC," a White House spokesperson told the BBC in a statement. It is not yet clear when construction of the arch could begin, as several lawsuits seek to block the project. The White House criticised the federal court that temporarily halted construction as an "activist district court." "We are confident we will be fully vindicated as this litigation proceeds and look forward to seeing the completion of this magnificent Arch," the spokesperson said. A rendering of the project's design from earlier this year includes a golden, winged Lady Liberty statue on the top of the arch, flanked by two gold eagles. The phrases "One Nation Under God" and "Liberty and Justice for All" are inscribed in gold on either side of the structure. A website that the White House shared on social media on Friday also shows a video rendering of the arch that shows the structure emblazoned with the words "Golden Age of America" along one side.

articles.title: Pope Leo heads to Latin America weeks after lung cancer surgery
articles.summary: Pope Leo, who had part of a lung removed last month, will visit Uruguay, Argentina and Peru.
articles.body_text: Pope Leo XIV is beginning a lengthy trip to Latin America just three weeks after surgery for lung cancer - a tour that includes a much-anticipated "homecoming" to Peru where he was a priest for many years. The Vatican says no extraordinary measures are being taken in relation to the Pope's health, describing him as a "71-year-old who has undergone an operation" not someone with a "permanent medical condition". It was Leo himself who revealed last month that doctors had discovered a tumour during a routine scan. The growth was removed along with the lower lobe of his right lung and his medical team then confirmed the cancer had not spread. At a briefing in Rome ahead of the trip, which takes in Uruguay and Argentina as well as Peru, a spokeswoman stressed that Pope Leo had "fantastic stamina" and was "extremely enthusiastic" about the schedule which he had "personally confirmed... with no changes". "The Vatican's message with this trip is, 'that was a short episode and now we're back on track'," Professor Massimo Faggioli of Villanova University told the BBC, pointing out that the Pope has had a busy return to work since his surgery. "We have seen him in these last few days making speeches, audiences and so on. He seems in great shape. That was important." The 12-day tour would be demanding for anyone, though. It incorporates multiple long-haul and local flights and covers thousands of miles from the Amazon to the Andes. The starting point will be Uruguay, where the number of Catholics has fallen away steeply in recent years and which is getting its first Papal visit in four decades. Leo then heads for Argentina, homeland of Pope Francis, his predecessor. "This visit is also a homage to Francis, who didn't make it to Argentina [as pope]," says Father Fernando Laguna, the rector of Santa Maria Addolorata, Argentina's national church in Rome. "When this visit by Pope Leo was announced, it filled all of our hearts with joy," he told the BBC. "I always thought he would go, despite his illness. I don't think he ever thought of calling it off!" The priest is installing a big screen inside the church in Rome to allow parishioners to follow all the key moments of the trip from afar. The building is already decked out with posters declaring Pope Leo is welcome in Argentina. "We're waiting for you!", one proclaims.

articles.title: Was an Italian chef really fired over pineapple on pizza row?

articles.body_text: Italian chef Davide Tamburella was fired from a Brisbane restaurant in May after the establishment's management expressed concerns about a string of complaints about the chef's behaviour. articles.title: Cita del día, Octavio Paz, poeta: “Nuestros instrumentos pueden medir el tiempo pero nosotros ya no podemos pensarlo: se ha vuelto demasiado grande y demasiado pequeño”
articles.summary: La cita del día corresponde al galardonado poeta mexicano Octavio Paz. Sus palabras nos intentan explicar sobre el sentido que le brindamos al tiempo con la presencia de la tecnología.
articles.body_text: Si bien contamos con herramientas capaces de medir los segundos con total exactitud, nuestra mente parece haber perdido la capacidad de comprender lo que realmente consiste el tiempo. Eso es lo que no intenta explicar la cita del día de Octavio Paz, al sostener que la percepción humana está siendo superada debido a que el tiempo se ha vuelto demasiado grande para abarcarlo y, a la vez, demasiado pequeño para retenerlo. La frase “Nuestros instrumentos pueden medir el tiempo pero nosotros ya no podemos pensarlo: se ha vuelto demasiado grande y demasiado pequeño” nos invita a reflexionar cómo la humanidad ha separado el tiempo de su propia experiencia interior. En la actualidad, somos capaces de medir cada segundo con relojes y calcular la existencia del universo con la ciencia, pero hemos perdido ese análisis para comprender qué significa el tiempo en nuestras propias vidas. Para nosotros, el tiempo nos enseña nuestra propia existencia: lo que fuimos, lo que afrontamos en el presente y lo que puede ofrecer en un futuro. Sin embargo, si intentamos controlarlo mediante la tecnología, nos convertimos dependientes de la prisa. En conclusión, las palabras de Octavio Paz nos enseña que, aunque dominemos la técnica de medir los minutos, se nos escapa la oportunidad de aprender a disfrutar del presente con sentido sin que se nos escape de las manos.

articles.title: Presidente de Paraguay no acude al Senado y delega a sus abogados para presentar defensa
articles.summary: Santiago Peña deberá acudir al Senado paraguayo para ejercer su defensa en el proceso de juicio político, luego de que rechazaran su pedido de más tiempo.
articles.body_text: Los abogados del presidente de Paraguay, Santiago Peña, acudieron este viernes al Senado para presentar la defensa “técnica” y “jurídica” del mandatario en el juicio político iniciado en su contra, que, pese a haber sido convocado en persona para comparecer ante el Legislativo, no asistió y delegó por ahora su representación, en medio del escándalo desatado por el cierre del privado Ueno Bank. Los letrados, Adolfo Ferreiro y Ricardo Preda, llegaron al pleno cerca de las 13.00 horas locales (16.00 GMT) y tras el rechazo del Senado al pedido de prórroga de 72 horas solicitado por Peña para ejercer su defensa. Peña, quien permanece formalmente en el cargo después de que el Congreso no se pronunció por falta de cuórum sobre la renuncia que presentó la víspera, había advertido poco antes que las 12 horas establecidas por el Senado para preparar su estrategia eran insuficientes. Paraguay atraviesa por una crisis política después de que el Banco Central (BCP) ordenó un proceso de resolución o cierre de Ueno bank, una institución que durante la gestión de Peña recibió millonarios recursos de entidades públicas. El BCP detectó que el índice de solvencia del banco, que controlaba los recursos de más de 2,9 millones de clientes, había caído por debajo del 50 % del mínimo exigido, “como consecuencia de ajustes realizados a sus estados financieros durante el proceso de regularización”. El jefe de Estado, señalado por sus vínculos con Ueno, terminó salpicado por la crisis y la víspera dimitió. Sin embargo, Peña permanece formalmente en la Presidencia de Paraguay ya que legisladores oficialistas dejaron sin cuórum la sesión conjunta convocada para votar su renuncia y así poder activar el mecanismo de sucesión tras declarar la vacancia del cargo. Si fuera destituido por el Parlamento, Peña perdería los fueros de senador vitalicio, que conservaría con la renuncia. Precisamente eso es lo que no quiere el Congreso, que lo convocó de manera inmediata al Senado, que actúa como juez, para el juicio político en el que está previsto que lo destituya.

articles.body_text: Dólar BCV en Venezuela hoy, miércoles 4 de noviembre de 2026. ¿Cuál es la cotización más reciente del dólar según el Banco Central de Venezuela (BCV)? Consulta el tipo de cambio del dólar estadounidense en Venezuela y conoce por qué es tan relevante conocer la tasa oficial del billete. articles.body_text: Con el final de ciertas celebraciones del año, muchos trabajadores y estudiantes ya empiezan a revisar el calendario para conocer cuál será el siguiente descanso oficial del año. Los feriados representan una oportunidad para planificar viajes, compartir tiempo en familia o simplemente hacer una pausa en la rutina, por lo que existe un gran interés en conocer las próximas fechas establecidas por ley. Además de permitir un espacio para el descanso, estas jornadas suelen generar un importante movimiento en sectores como el turismo, el comercio, la gastronomía y el transporte, debido al incremento de personas que aprovechan los días libres para salir de la ciudad o realizar diversas actividades. Del mismo modo, muchas empresas y entidades organizan con anticipación sus operaciones para adecuarse al calendario oficial, mientras que las familias aprovechan estas fechas para programar reuniones, escapadas de fin de semana o visitas a distintos destinos del país. Por ello, conocer con anticipación cuándo será el próximo feriado resulta clave para organizar la agenda personal y laboral, evitar contratiempos y sacar el máximo provecho a los días de descanso que aún quedan en el 2026. Si quieres saber cuándo será el próximo feriado y qué fechas aún quedan por disfrutar este año, aquí te contamos todos los detalles. Los feriados son fechas establecidas por ley en las que los trabajadores tienen derecho a suspender sus labores sin que ello afecte su remuneración. Durante estas jornadas, el descanso es obligatorio tanto para el sector público como para el privado, salvo en aquellas actividades que, por su naturaleza, deben continuar operando. A diferencia del feriado, el día no laborable no constituye un descanso obligatorio para todos los trabajadores. Generalmente, esta medida se aplica al sector público con el objetivo de extender periodos de descanso o promover actividades como el turismo interno. En el caso de las entidades públicas, las horas que no se trabajan deben recuperarse posteriormente, dentro del plazo fijado por la normativa o según lo disponga cada institución. Para el sector privado, la aplicación de un día no laborable depende de un acuerdo entre empleador y trabajadores. articles.body_text: El precio del dólar cerró este viernes en S/3,426 en el mercado interbancario peruano, por debajo de los S/3,445 de la jornada anterior, con una caída de 0,55%. Este resultado fortaleció las perspectivas de un nuevo incremento de tasas de interés de la Reserva Federal en diciembre, favoreciendo a la divisa estadounidense frente a sus principales pares”, explicó Jorge Luis Huayta, trader FX de Kambista. En los mercados internacionales, el petróleo WTI retrocedió 0,83%, hasta US$89,77 por barril, mientras el oro cayó 0,58%. En contraste, el cobre avanzó 0,49% y la plata subió 0,25%. Las bolsas estadounidenses también registraron una recuperación, con un incremento de 1,34% del Nasdaq 100 y de 0,43% del S&P 500. En América Latina, el peso mexicano se apreció 0,67% y el real brasileño 0,11%, mientras el peso colombiano retrocedió 0,21%. En el mercado local, el tipo de cambio fluctuó entre S/3,421 y S/3,447, con un volumen negociado de US$510.8 millones. Asimismo, los riesgos asociados al Fenómeno El Niño Costero seguirán siendo relevantes para las perspectivas económicas, luego de que el ENFEN advirtiera sobre la posibilidad de lluvias superiores a lo normal entre noviembre y enero, con potenciales efectos sobre la agricultura, la pesca y la infraestructura del país. Jesús Flores Ríos, gerente comercial de intermediación de Divisas en Renta4 SAB, agregó que el mercado laboral de EE.UU. mostró una fortaleza mayor a la esperada en octubre, con la creación de 165 mil empleos, frente a los 65 mil previstos, y una caída del desempleo a 4,1%. En conjunto, estos resultados sugieren un mercado laboral resistente, lo que podría reforzar la cautela de la Fed para reducir las tasas, ante posibles presiones inflacionarias. y el índice DXY cotizó en 102.31 (+0,74%).

articles.title: Presidente de Paraguay no acude al Senado y delega a sus abogados para presentar defensa
articles.summary: Santiago Peña deberá acudir al Senado paraguayo para ejercer su defensa en el proceso de juicio político, luego de que rechazaran su pedido de más tiempo.
articles.body_text: Los abogados del presidente de Paraguay, Santiago Peña, acudieron este viernes al Senado para presentar la defensa “técnica” y “jurídica” del mandatario en el juicio político iniciado en su contra, que, pese a haber sido convocado en persona para comparecer ante el Legislativo, no asistió y delegó por ahora su representación, en medio del escándalo desatado por el cierre del privado Ueno Bank. Los letrados, Adolfo Ferreiro y Ricardo Preda, llegaron al pleno cerca de las 13.00 horas locales (16.00 GMT) y tras el rechazo del Senado al pedido de prórroga de 72 horas solicitado por Peña para ejercer su defensa. Peña, quien permanece formalmente en el cargo después de que el Congreso no se pronunció por falta de cuórum sobre la renuncia que presentó la víspera, había advertido poco antes que las 12 horas establecidas por el Senado para preparar su estrategia eran insuficientes. Paraguay atraviesa por una crisis política después de que el Banco Central (BCP) ordenó un proceso de resolución o cierre de Ueno bank, una institución que durante la gestión de Peña recibió millonarios recursos de entidades públicas. El BCP detectó que el índice de solvencia del banco, que controlaba los recursos de más de 2,9 millones de clientes, había caído por debajo del 50 % del mínimo exigido, “como consecuencia de ajustes realizados a sus estados financieros durante el proceso de regularización”. El jefe de Estado, señalado por sus vínculos con Ueno, terminó salpicado por la crisis y la víspera dimitió. Sin embargo, Peña permanece formalmente en la Presidencia de Paraguay ya que legisladores oficialistas dejaron sin cuórum la sesión conjunta convocada para votar su renuncia y así poder activar el mecanismo de sucesión tras declarar la vacancia del cargo. Si fuera destituido por el Parlamento, Peña perdería los fueros de senador vitalicio, que conservaría con la renuncia. Precisamente eso es lo que no quiere el Congreso, que lo convocó de manera inmediata al Senado, que actúa como juez, para el juicio político en el que está previsto que lo destituya.

articles.title: Presidente de Paraguay no acude al Senado y delega a sus abogados para presentar defensa
articles.summary: Santiago Peña deberá acudir al Senado paraguayo para ejercer su defensa en el proceso de juicio político, luego de que rechazaran su pedido de más tiempo.
articles.body_text: Los abogados del presidente de Paraguay, Santiago Peña, acudieron este viernes al Senado para presentar la defensa “técnica” y “jurídica” del mandatario en el juicio político iniciado en su contra, que, pese a haber sido convocado en persona para comparecer ante el Legislativo, no asistió y delegó por ahora su representación, en medio del escándalo desatado por el cierre del privado Ueno Bank. Los letrados, Adolfo Ferreiro y Ricardo Preda, llegaron al pleno cerca de las 13.00 horas locales (16.00 GMT) y tras el rechazo del Senado al pedido de prórroga de 72 horas solicitado por Peña para ejercer su defensa. Peña, quien permanece formalmente en el cargo después de que el Congreso no se pronunció por falta de cuórum sobre la renuncia que presentó la víspera, había advertido poco antes que las 12 horas establecidas por el Senado para preparar su estrategia eran insuficientes. Paraguay atraviesa por una crisis política después de que el Banco Central (BCP) ordenó un proceso de resolución o cierre de Ueno bank, una institución que durante la gestión de Peña recibió millonarios recursos de entidades públicas. El BCP detectó que el índice de solvencia del banco, que controlaba los recursos de más de 2,9 millones de clientes, había caído por debajo del 50 % del mínimo exigido, “como consecuencia de ajustes realizados a sus estados financieros durante el proceso de regularización”. El jefe de Estado, señalado por sus vínculos con Ueno, terminó salpicado por la crisis y la víspera dimitió. Sin embargo, Peña permanece formalmente en la Presidencia de Paraguay ya que legisladores oficialistas dejaron sin cuórum la sesión conjunta convocada para votar su renuncia y así poder activar el mecanismo de sucesión tras declarar la vacancia del cargo. Si fuera destituido por el Parlamento, Peña perdería los fueros de senador vitalicio, que conservaría con la renuncia. Precisamente eso es lo que no quiere el Congreso, que lo convocó de manera inmediata al Senado, que actúa como juez, para el juicio político en el que está previsto que lo destituya.

articles.title: Presidente de Paraguay no acude al Senado y delega a sus abogados para presentar defensa
articles.summary: Santiago Peña deberá acudir al Senado paraguayo para ejercer su defensa en el proceso de juicio político, luego de que rechazaran su pedido de más tiempo.
articles.body_text: Los abogados del presidente de Paraguay, Santiago Peña, acudieron este viernes al Senado para presentar la defensa “técnica” y “jurídica” del mandatario en el juicio político iniciado en su contra, que, pese a haber sido convocado en persona para comparecer ante el Legislativo, no asistió y delegó por ahora su representación, en medio del escándalo desatado por el cierre del privado Ueno Bank. Los letrados, Adolfo Ferreiro y Ricardo Preda, llegaron al pleno cerca de las 13.00 horas locales (16.00 GMT) y tras el rechazo del Senado al pedido de prórroga de 72 horas solicitado por Peña para ejercer su defensa. Peña, quien permanece formalmente en el cargo después de que el Congreso no se pronunció por falta de cuórum sobre la renuncia que presentó la víspera, había advertido poco antes que las 12 horas establecidas por el Senado para preparar su estrategia eran insuficientes. Paraguay atraviesa por una crisis política después de que el Banco Central (BCP) ordenó un proceso de resolución o cierre de Ueno bank, una institución que durante la gestión de Peña recibió millonarios recursos de entidades públicas. El BCP detectó que el índice de solvencia del banco, que controlaba los recursos de más de 2,9 millones de clientes, había caído por debajo del 50 % del mínimo exigido, “como consecuencia de ajustes realizados a sus estados financieros durante el proceso de regularización”. El jefe de Estado, señalado por sus vínculos con Ueno, terminó salpicado por la crisis y la víspera dimitió. Sin embargo, Peña permanece formalmente en la Presidencia de Paraguay ya que legisladores oficialistas dejaron sin cuórum la sesión conjunta convocada para votar su renuncia y así poder activar el mecanismo de sucesión tras declarar la vacancia del cargo. Si fuera destituido por el Parlamento, Peña perdería los fueros de senador vitalicio, que conservaría con la renuncia. Precisamente eso es lo que no quiere el Congreso, que lo convocó de manera inmediata al Senado, que actúa como juez, para el juicio político en el que está previsto que lo destituya.

articles.body_text: Con el final de ciertas celebraciones del año, muchos trabajadores y estudiantes ya empiezan a revisar el calendario para conocer cuál será el siguiente descanso oficial del año. Los feriados representan una oportunidad para planificar viajes, compartir tiempo en familia o simplemente hacer una pausa en la rutina, por lo que existe un gran interés en conocer las próximas fechas establecidas por ley. Además de permitir un espacio para el descanso, estas jornadas suelen generar un importante movimiento en sectores como el turismo, el comercio, la gastronomía y el transporte, debido al incremento de personas que aprovechan los días libres para salir de la ciudad o realizar diversas actividades. Del mismo modo, muchas empresas y entidades organizan con anticipación sus operaciones para adecuarse al calendario oficial, mientras que las familias aprovechan estas fechas para programar reuniones, escapadas de fin de semana o visitas a distintos destinos del país. Por ello, conocer con anticipación cuándo será el próximo feriado resulta clave para organizar la agenda personal y laboral, evitar contratiempos y sacar el máximo provecho a los días de descanso que aún quedan en el 2026. A continuación, te contaremos todo lo que debes saber sobre esta situación. Si quieres saber cuándo será el próximo feriado y qué fechas aún quedan por disfrutar este año, aquí te contamos todos los detalles. Los feriados son fechas establecidas por ley en las que los trabajadores tienen derecho a suspender sus labores sin que ello afecte su remuneración. Durante estas jornadas, el descanso es obligatorio tanto para el sector público como para el privado, salvo en aquellas actividades que, por su naturaleza, deben continuar operando. Si un trabajador presta servicios durante un feriado y no recibe un día de descanso compensatorio, la legislación laboral establece que le corresponde una remuneración adicional por haber laborado en esa fecha, conforme a las disposiciones vigentes. A diferencia del feriado, el día no laborable no constituye un descanso obligatorio para todos los trabajadores. Generalmente, esta medida se aplica al sector público con el objetivo de extender periodos de descanso o promover actividades como el turismo interno. En el caso de las entidades públicas, las horas que no se trabajan deben recuperarse posteriormente, dentro del plazo fijado por la normativa o según lo disponga cada institución. Para el sector privado, la aplicación de un día no laborable depende de un acuerdo entre empleador y trabajadores. Si no existe consenso sobre la recuperación de las horas, será el empleador quien determine la forma en que estas deberán compensarse.

articles.title: Crusoe sells troubled Wyoming data center project to Google | TechCrunch
articles.summary: The deal highlights the challenges of developing massive AI data centers.
articles.body_text: Crusoe, an eight-year-old, Denver-based data center developer recently valued at $30.9 billion , confirmed Friday it has sold an unfinished data center project in southeastern Wyoming to Google. Google, which Crusoe had tried and failed to land as a customer for the project, is taking over the development after reportedly raising concerns about its cost and construction timeline under Crusoe’s management. Crusoe initially announced the project last year with Blackstone-backed infrastructure company Tallgrass, planning to eventually scale it to 10 gigawatts of power capacity. Google did not disclose how much it paid Crusoe for the unfinished project, bu it announced plans to invest $17 billion to develop the data center campus. The deal highlights how difficult it can be for independent data center developers to deliver massive projects on time and within budget, given the challenges of securing equipment and power. Growing opposition from local communities can further complicate development. Despite taking over the Wyoming facility, Google hasn’t walked away from working with Crusoe entirely. Crusoe is developing another data center for Google near Amarillo, Texas. The deal to sell the site to Google was first reported by Bloomberg in June, but the Wyoming setback didn’t stop Crusoe from raising a $3.9 billion round in September. Crusoe makes money by leasing data center space to customers that bring their own GPUs, by renting out its own GPUs, and by selling compute power used to run AI models, known as inference. Crusoe’s largest projects serve some of the biggest names in AI. Its campus in Abilene, Texas, is being built in phases for Oracle and OpenAI, and the company is also constructing a separate 900-megawatt campus next door for Microsoft, with its first building expected to come online in mid-2027. Meta is also a customer, and Bloomberg reported that the trading firm Jane Street signed a $13 billion , five-year cloud deal with Crusoe. Crusoe was founded by Chase Lochmiller, now its CEO, and Cully Cavness, who started it as a cryptocurrency-mining business powered by natural gas that would otherwise have been burned off. In September, alongside its $3.9 billion funding round, the company added three board members , including JB Straubel, the Redwood Materials founder and Tesla board member who invested in Crusoe in 2021. articles.title: The Duo apps are coming, says Apple | TechCrunch
articles.summary: There are now 100,000 Duo-optimized apps, says Apple, and thousands more arrive daily.
articles.body_text: The early iPhone Duo reviews were a bit hard on Apple’s new foldable for the lack of Duo-optimized apps available at the time of launch. But Apple says things are changing quickly on the software front. The company on Friday announced there are now over 100,000 apps built for the Duo live on the App Store, and it’s seeing thousands more being added to the store every day. The news was timed alongside the release of over a dozen more notable Duo-ready apps, including Microsoft Word and Outlook, Zoom, sports apps from the NBA and NHL, shopping apps like Etsy and LTK, productivity apps like Goodnotes and Extra, the Halide Mark III camera app, and others. These join the iPhone Duo-optimized apps that were already available, like Netflix, YouTube, Instagram, and WhatsApp. Non-optimized apps are definitely less than ideal, as they come with a black bar on the side of the screen, which takes up valuable space. Sometimes, they hide important functions under an overflow menu. Apple’s data seems to suggest that at least some iOS developers may have needed extra time to get their apps ready for its latest form factor. The company said that more than 2,000 app developers attended its over 50 in-person workshops that were hosted across 19 cities worldwide. Here, the developers could use the Duo and work on their apps with Apple’s support. The Duo has also proven to be more popular than perhaps Apple had planned for, given its high price point. (It starts at $1,999 for the 256GB model.) The device quickly sold out within hours of orders opening up, and now, Duo ship times have shifted into the next year. On its earnings call this week, Apple said it’s “hard to predict” when the Duo constraints leading to those delays will improve . “It’s been wonderful to see how quickly developers have embraced iPhone Duo, and we’re grateful for their creativity and innovation,” said Susan Prescott, Apple’s vice president of Worldwide Developer Relations, in a statement referring to the 100,000-app milestone. “The enthusiasm has been incredible, and we’re excited to see the pace of updates continue to accelerate as more and more apps optimize for iPhone Duo,” she added. articles.title: Hundreds of Artex AI hacking tools found publicly exposed to the web | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Security researchers found hundreds of servers hosting the penetration testing tool Artex exposed to the internet, allowing anyone access to the hacking tool.
articles.body_text: Security researchers have discovered hundreds of copies of a Chinese-made AI hacking tool publicly exposed to the internet for anyone to access, potentially allowing outsiders to launch cyberattacks against unsuspecting targets. The hacking software, called Artex, is an open source autonomous penetration testing tool, meaning software that automatically probes computer systems for weaknesses, and it’s been linked to several cyberattacks since its public release in July. As open source software, it’s free for anyone to download and run on their own servers, making it a popular tool for those who cannot access Anthropic or OpenAI’s most advanced cybersecurity AI models for discovering security vulnerabilities. Microsoft has previously described Artex as a system of AI agents that can conduct cyberattacks “from reconnaissance through data exfiltration with little needed human interaction.” In a blog post , cybersecurity firm Censys, which scans the internet for exposed or vulnerable systems, said that it identified more than 800 distinct deployments of Artex that were accessible from the web without needing a password to log in. Silas Cutler, principal security researcher at Censys who wrote the blog post, said that not every instance of Artex is operated maliciously and many are used for authorized testers. But it’s unclear why hundreds of these Artex systems are exposed to the web, as the software does not require them to be accessible from the internet. The findings underscore how even powerful hacking tools can be misconfigured to be publicly accessible by anyone, increasing the chance that someone will find and misuse them. The publicly accessible systems also expose attack tools, such as implants (hidden malicious software) used to compromise and maintain persistent access to a victim’s network. Security companies have linked the use of Artex to several broad-scale cyberattacks, including against the Korean finance industry in September . Cybersecurity giant CrowdStrike attributed the attacks to a Chinese-speaking hacker who used an Artex instance in the attacks, in part because the hacker had left an “open directory” hosting the system. Censys said that its data showed the Artex instance in question had been publicly exposed for months, and appeared to contain more attack data that extended “well beyond South Korean banks,” including payment and gaming companies. Artex was also used in an attack on IT support giant ConnectWise earlier in October , which allowed Chinese-linked hackers to spy on thousands of organizations whose data and files are hosted in Microsoft’s cloud. Microsoft, which has visibility into the attack, said in a blog post that the hackers used Artex to break into customers’ cloud environments and steal their data at such speed that defenders had “little time to detect and respond.” Many of the attacks linked to Artex involved exploiting simple vulnerabilities, such as guessing weak or known passwords, and a lack of multi-factor authentication. The findings show that simple vulnerabilities, including misconfigurations, can expose both the attacker and their targets. Artex has since announced it would go closed-source, effectively limiting further releases for paid customers. There are still dozens of copies of Artex’s code available on code-sharing sites that can still be used in active attacks. articles.title: Meta introduces Spaces, a new way to collaborate with your Muse agent | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Meta's Muse agents continue to get new features and integrations. Spaces promises to be a new way to interact with the AI helpers.
articles.body_text: Meta recently launched its Muse agents — a new generation of cuddly agentic helpers. Now, the company has launched Spaces, a new way to communicate and collaborate with them. As far as I can tell, Spaces are basically breakout conversations that revolve around a particular topic — although Meta refers to them as “custom experiences.” They live in the sidebar of the interface where you interact with your Muse agent. Clicking on the Space brings up the conversation, where Muse works toward a particular goal on your behalf. For instance, if you wanted to plan a vacation, you could open a new Space focused on that particular project, and whenever you want to work on it with Muse, you would click to open that particular tab. Or, if you’re focused on collecting recipes for an upcoming family event, you’d open a new Space for that particular project. Other examples Meta gives are a holiday gift tracker, a wedding planner, or a space for DIY projects. “Describe an idea in chat, and Muse builds a space for you, whether that’s a tracker, a planner or a project board,” Meta says. Spaces can also be easily integrated with third-party apps and information, Meta says. “Connect the apps you use, and your spaces keep themselves up to date in the background, so new concert dates, price changes, or savings progress show up without you having to ask,” the company says. On Friday, Mark Zuckerberg, Meta’s founder and CEO, posted about the new feature on X: “Playing around with spaces in Muse lately — tell Muse what you need and it builds it. I’ve made a BBQ game, an event tracker, and a home control dashboard. Excited to see what you build.” Muse agents — and the cuddly avatars that enclose them — have been greeted with a relatively warm reception over the past few months. During its earnings call in October, Zuckerberg said that its agents had 10 million users in the U.S. and Canada — less than two months after the agents debuted. The company is obviously busy building out the user experience around the agents. Spaces is actually the second new Muse feature that Meta has debuted over the last week. On Thursday, the company also announced Muse Voice , which allows users to video chat with their agent and give it commands verbally. The company is in competition with other cute and cuddly AI agents — including OpenAI’s dots and SpaceXAI’s Grokbot , which were debuted with similarly cartoonish personas. articles.title: Ramp data shows AI spending stalling just as Anthropic nears its IPO | TechCrunch
articles.summary: AI usage keeps climbing, but spending has stalled. Price cuts and smarter cost controls among the biggest spenders could challenge investor assumptions about AI hypergrowth.
articles.body_text: Companies are using more AI than ever, but they’re not spending more on it. A new report from Ramp shows AI spending flatlined over late summer even as token volumes rose, a sign that price competition and savvier customers may be capping revenue for OpenAI and Anthropic. According to Ramp’s data, token spend only grew 1.5% across August and September. To compare, in July, it grew 42% from the previous month. As Anthropic gears up for its IPO , the data suggests investors might be wrong to assume AI companies will keep growing at breakneck speed. “Almost the entire spend on AI is from venture-backed, high-growth tech companies,” Ramp’s lead economist Ara Kharazian told TechCrunch. “That’s fine as long as AI spend continues to rise, but if it starts to slow down because of something in the market or some other factor, they will all start to slow down simultaneously, and that could lead to other cascading effects.” Kharazian said he’s already seeing evidence that the top 1% of firms — the most “ AI-pilled ” — have stuttered slightly in their spend in August and September, coming up just below the $10,000 per-employee they were hitting at their summer peaks. A slowdown among that cohort is “sufficient to slow down revenue entirely, despite the fact that we’re seeing rising volumes,” he said. Ramp data shows growth in spending among median and top 10%, but it’s not enough to make up the difference. Median firms spend $12-$15 per employee per month, and the top 10% spend $600-$1,000. “If you look at the use cases today, it’s not necessarily clear they will get up to that $10,000 per employee per month mark that the 1% is at,” Kharazian said. While there’s plenty of demand for AI coding agents in industries like software and finance, “it’s not necessarily true that a doctor’s office or a car dealership will need to spend that much on AI.” “The era of hypergrowth may be over, and now that we know there may not be as much juice to squeeze out of the top 1%,” he continued. October data did see a re-acceleration, with token spend up 8.9% from September 23 to October 23, but Kharazian said the headwinds on spend growth are strong. Kharazian (who has published a series of blogs called “ Cracks in the AI Thesis ”) said the slowdown isn’t due to a demand problem. Again, AI volumes are up. Instead he points to the competitive nature of the marketplace. “OpenAI and Anthropic price cuts have…just made it cheaper to use AI,” he said. In September, OpenAI cut API prices in half for GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna. Answering the price war, Anthropic has also made significant reductions to pricing for Fable 5.1 and Opus 5.5 — a decision that the company said in a recent filing slashed revenue growth by about $600 million. Both companies have also been offering enterprise discounts that are intended to lock-in spend, but in reality are hitting their revenue targets. Kharazian said this dynamic means it has very much become a buyer’s market.

articles.title: After blocking Muse, Amazon now lets users text Alexa to help them shop | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Amazon said that the feature will roll out to millions of users in coming weeks.
articles.body_text: Amazon is jumping on the currently most popular bandwagon for interacting with AI agents: texting. The company on Friday said it is launching a feature that lets customers chat with its Alexa AI agent over text messages to help them shop, much like you can with AI agents like Muse or Instinct. The move comes after Amazon blocked Meta’s Muse from querying its site in September. The company is rolling the features out just before the start of the holiday shopping season. The e-commerce giant said select U.S. customers will get a text asking them to enable the shopping feature. Those with access can text Alexa to shop on Amazon using natural language queries, spanning everything from searching for items, adding them to cart, and purchasing. The text agent builds on the recent shopping-focused upgrades to Alexa , and so can manage lists, keep tabs on prices, search for items across the web, compare products, and check the status of orders. Users can also share a picture of an item or someone wearing an outfit to search for similar listings on Amazon. The company said over time, Alexa will learn users’ preferences and suggest items accordingly. As the market for consumer-focused AI agents balloons, platforms like Amazon are building their own to tap this new avenue of user interaction. Last month, delivery company DoorDash said that third-party agents had so far only placed hundreds of orders in total on its platform, and that it plans to concentrate on developing its own text-based agent, launched in September , further. articles.title: Tesla will stop making the Cybertruck in 2027 | TechCrunch
articles.summary: The decision to wind down the EV comes after just a few short years of underwhelming sales. Elon Musk said the company will use the factory space to make more Cybercabs.
articles.body_text: Tesla will stop making the Cybertruck next year, according to CEO Elon Musk, who said on X that the company will use the factory space to build more two-seater Cybercab robotaxis. The decision to wind down the futuristic, steel-clad EV comes after just a few short years of underwhelming sales. When Musk handed over the first few Cybertrucks in late 2023, he predicted Tesla would sell around 250,000 per year. It was supposed to be such a cornerstone of Tesla’s future that, before construction began, the company talked about its Texas factory as the “Cybertruck factory.” But Tesla has instead sold just tens of thousands — total — over the last three years. Tesla is killing off the Cybertruck at a moment when it is trying to become an AI- and robotics-focused company. A big part of that is its robotaxi ambitions. The company has spent the last two months putting Cybercabs on the streets in its hometown of Austin, Texas. With no major incidents to date, the company has said it plans to expand the Cybercabs operations to other cities, starting with Dallas later this month. (Tesla also operates robotaxi versions of its Model Y SUVs in Austin, Houston, and Dallas, as well as three cities in Florida.) This is the third product Tesla has discontinued in order to fuel those greater ambitions. Earlier this year, the company decided to end production of the Model S sedan and Model X SUV and instead use the factory space dedicated to those vehicles to make Optimus humanoid robots. First announced in 2019, the Cybertruck was a product that Musk had long obsessed over. “Probably my personal favorite for the next product is the pickup truck, and we are going to just do an amazing pickup truck,” he said on one of Tesla’s earnings calls that year. Musk promised the Cybertruck would be radical, inspired by the designs of cyberpunk sci-fi stories like “Blade Runner.” While that certainly bore out in the design, the company overpromised on the basics of the Cybertruck from the jump. During the now-infamous reveal event in 2019, when head designer Franz von Holzhausen cracked the Cybertruck’s windows with steel balls, Tesla said the EV was supposed to start at under $40,000 and have up to 500 miles of range. It achieved neither of those figures. Instead, the truck was delayed for two years, in part because of the COVID-19 pandemic. When it finally did hit the market in late 2023, Tesla handed over the first few Cybertrucks to customers in a short, somewhat odd for Tesla event (by the company’s own standards, at least), which saw a poorly-lit Musk standing in a truck bed promising the truck was “the finest in apocalyptic equipment” fit for “late civilization vibes.” The base price had inflated to around $60,000, and the top-end range had shrunk by over 100 miles. The truck has struggled on the market ever since. The polarizing design never seemed to sit well with buyers, especially at a higher-than-expected price. Then, during its first full year of sales in 2024, Musk became a major financial backer of Donald Trump, which turned the instantly recognizable Cybertruck into a target for protesters. That continued into 2025 as Musk led the so-called Department of Government Efficiency, which fired thousands of federal workers.
