articles.title: At least 10 local governments have moved to drop Flock’s surveillance cameras since summer | TechCrunch
articles.summary: The concerns range from privacy to how data is shared (and with whom) to procurement concerns.
articles.body_text: Flock, founded in 2017, sells surveillance software that can help solve crimes, such as finding missing people or stolen cars. Its products include license plate readers, drones, and microphone-based edge-computing devices to pick up gunshots and other sounds. More than 100,000 Flock cameras are in use nationwide. But in the past three months, Monroe , Ohio; Newburgh , New York; Richmond , Virginia; Hopkinton, Massachusetts; New Bedford , Massachusetts; and Lansing , Michigan, have all moved to end their contracts with Flock. Meanwhile, police in East Bridgewater and Grafton, Massachusetts, also announced plans to stop using Flock cameras. Just this week, residents of League City, Texas, voted against their police department’s continued use of Flock’s license plate readers, and the cameras are now set to be removed. In Asheville, North Carolina, police lost access to Flock after the city voted to terminate its contract in August, and the El Paso County Sheriff’s Office in Colorado announced in September that it would stop using Flock cameras. When asked for comment, the El Paso County Sheriff’s Office redirected TechCrunch to its press release, where Sheriff Joseph Roybal said that discontinuing the use of Flock was the right decision for the county. “We have the tools, training, and experience to locate and apprehend criminals without relying on Flock cameras,” he said in the press release. Misuse has been a real problem. In August, for example, an officer in Brentwood, Missouri was accused of using Flock cameras to stalk his ex-wife during their divorce. In September, an officer from East Texas was sentenced to prison for using Flock to stalk his ex-girlfriend and her family. Another growing concern is how immigration officials have been able to access the technology. One case that captures the issue came in March, when Ithaca, New York, passed a resolution to terminate its contract with the Flock Group. In the resolution, the city said there were “proven instances of Flock Safety infrastructure being used by federal agents for information purposes even without specific authorizations from the contracting locality,” and that the city had reviewed reports that “either intentionally or through its negligence,” Flock had allowed U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) and the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives (ATF) to “use query results from its database of state and local ALPR [automatic license plate reader] data to investigate and persecute immigrants throughout the United States.” “Every day, police departments across the country are using Flock technology to solve serious crimes, locate suspects, find missing people, and make a measurable impact on public safety,” Flock told TechCrunch in a statement. “While we respect every community’s decision, removing a tool that is actively helping solve violent crimes and protect communities moves public safety backward. Every Flock customer owns its data and controls who it is shared with and how it can be used. Flock does not sell data and does not have a contract with ICE.” This August, Flock announced it would shorten the default period it stores data for new customers, from 30 days to seven. It also said agencies now need a case code before they can search the database. That lack of awareness is similar to how data centers are popping up across the country, often before residents understand what is happening. Schwartz said police departments often decide to use Flock on their own, with little oversight from city councils. In South Windsor , Connecticut, according to local reports, Flock cameras went live last year without public warning or a vote. In October, the town voted to remove its Flock cameras. “Grassroots activists across the country have been demanding that city councils exercise their procurement power to refuse to pay for ALPRs,” Schwartz said, referring to councils’ power to decide what the city buys. He added that activists have been fighting for years and that “many city councils are listening.” The main argument for technology like Flock is that it helps combat crime and keep neighborhoods safe. And many local governments are not dropping Flock or similar technology; instead, they are adding restrictions on its use or looking for alternatives.

articles.title: Palo Alto Networks in talks to buy AI agent security startup Clutch for $500M | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Clutch, backed by Lightspeed and SignalFire, was last valued at $85 million, according to a source.
articles.body_text: Palo Alto Networks is in talks to acquire Clutch Security , a startup that secures AI agents’ access to company systems, for $500 million in cash plus additional milestone-based payouts, according to a person familiar with the discussions. Three-year-old Clutch was last valued at $85 million when it raised a $20 million Series A round in January 2025, led by Lightspeed and SignalFire, according to our source. The startup is currently approaching $10 million in annual recurring revenue (ARR). That means the acquisition, if completed, would value Clutch at about 50 times its ARR, a standard way of pricing software companies. Palo Alto Networks and Clutch Security did not respond to a request for comment. The Information was the first to report the acquisition discussions. The high valuation is not an anomaly in a market increasingly focused on securing software against bad actors using AI to breach systems more easily. Upwind, a startup using AI to secure cloud infrastructure, recently turned down an acquisition offer from Datadog that valued it at roughly 40 times ARR, TechCrunch reported last week. If the deal happens, it would be Palo Alto Networks’ seventh acquisition this year, according to PitchBook. The cybersecurity giant has a history of buying innovation rather than building it in-house, and it has ramped up dealmaking this year in response to rising AI-driven cyberattacks. In September, Palo Alto Networks acquired Console, a two-year-old startup that uses AI agents to automate routine IT help desk tasks. The transaction valued Console at $500 million in stock and cash, TechCrunch reported. Other VC-backed companies that Palo Alto Networks has scooped up this year include NEA-backed Embrace, for $325 million ; Chronosphere, an observability platform backed by Greylock and Lux Capital, for $2.95 billion ; and Koi, a cyber startup backed by Battery and Team8, for $231 million , according to regulatory filings. Several of Clutch’s competitors have also been acquired. Cyera, a cybersecurity startup valued at $12 billion earlier this year, acquired Oasis Security, which, like Clutch, focuses on managing AI agents’ access to systems, for $1 billion . Meanwhile, Cisco bought Menlo Ventures-backed Astrix for roughly $400 million , Calcalist reported. When you purchase through links in our articles, we may earn a small commission . articles.title: 3D DRAM created by IBM and Micron, 128GBps memory on the way
articles.summary: Smaller and faster RAM with up to 128GB transfer speed scould be on the way thanks to research from IBM and MIcron, using stacked chips and TSVs.
articles.body_text: Smaller and faster RAM with up to 128GBps transfer speeds could be on the way thanks to research from IBM and MIcron. The companies have developed three-dimensional memory, stacking individual DRAM chips vertically that would normally have to be placed side-by-side, though the efficiencies gained aren’t solely down to space. Communication between the stacked chips and the host device is achieved through a new creation known as through-silicon vias, or TSVs, which run vertically through the pile of chips and act as conduits to the host device. Thanks to the TSVs, in testing the memory has reached data speeds of 128GBps, ten times faster than current memory. On top of this, IBM claims the chips are 70 percent more power efficient than today’s DRAM. The new research is expected to form a key part of Samsung and Micron’s Hybrid Memory Cube technology, first announced back in October. IBM and Micron hope to have commercial availability in two years, with servers likely to use it first. Looking beyond that, IBM fellow Subu Iyer said that the new process “will have applications beyond memory, enabling other industry segments as well.” What exactly those new segments are remains to be seen, but we certainly wouldn’t complain if our computers got the kind of speed bump described here.

Communication between the stacked chips and the host device is achieved through a new creation known as through-silicon vias, or TSVs, which run vertically through the pile of chips and act as conduits to the host device. Thanks to the TSVs, in testing the memory has reached data speeds of 128GBps, ten times faster than current memory. On top of this, IBM claims the chips are 70 percent more power efficient than today’s DRAM. The new research is expected to form a key part of Samsung and Micron’s Hybrid Memory Cube technology, first announced back in October. IBM and Micron hope to have commercial availability in two years, with servers likely to use it first. Looking beyond that, IBM fellow Subu Iyer said that the new process “will have applications beyond memory, enabling other industry segments as well.” What exactly those new segments are remains to be seen, but we certainly wouldn’t complain if our computers got the kind of speed bump described here.

President Donald Trumps sändebud Jared Kushner uppgav i veckan att ett omfattande fredsavtal behövs i Europa. Efter att ha träffat Putins sändebud Kiril Dmitriev i Vita huset på torsdagen sa Trump: – Det kommer att bli ett stort avtal. Det kommer att involvera mer än Ukraina, och jag skulle till och med kunna säga att det kan involvera hela Europa. Tre europeiska tjänstemän uppgav för CNN att de inte visste vad Kushner eller Trump syftade på. Ukrainas president Zelenskyj har sagt att han känner till få detaljer om förslaget och varnade för att det inte skulle bli enkelt. ”Månader av diskussioner i Miami, Abu Dhabi, Alaska, Istanbul och Genève har bara bevisat en sak: Moskva vill ha sina mål uppfyllda innan de avslutar kriget”, står det i CNN-analysen. Ukrainas plötsliga återkomst på Trumps agenda ”har ökat pulsen i europeiska huvudstäder”. – Vi kommer oundvikligen att se Trump fokusera på Ukraina nu efter mellanårsvalet, säger en europeisk tjänsteman. Men ett avtal ”kan inte påtvingas Ukraina utan deras samtycke”. – Ukrainas behov av europeiska partners är större än att tvingas acceptera en rysk lösning, även om Trump försöker driva igenom det, säger tjänstemannen.

articles.title: Gabrielsson (V) pikar Thand Ringqvist (C): ”Vet att det inte går – märkligt”
articles.summary: Andersson eller Kristersson? C vill att S och M presenterar varsitt ”totalpaket” för hur de vill styra Sverige och förklara hur de ska begränsa inflytandet för V och SD. V-toppen Ida Gabrielsson tycker att uppdraget till M-ledaren är ”märkligt”, eftersom C ”vet att det inte går”.
articles.body_text: C vill att S och M presenterar varsitt ”totalpaket” för hur de vill styra Sverige och förklara hur de ska begränsa inflytandet för V och SD. V-toppen Ida Gabrielsson tycker att uppdraget till M-ledaren är ”märkligt”, eftersom C ”vet att det inte går”. Ljuduppspelningen är AI-genererad. Felaktigheter kan förekomma. Vid lunchtid på fredagen meddelade Sverigedemokraternas ledare Jimmie Åkesson att partiet kan släppa fram en borgerlig fyrpartiregering och att man kommer att gå i opposition. Några timmar senare höll Centerpartiets ledare Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist en pressträff där hon riktade ett tydligt krav till de två statsministerkandidaterna. – Centerpartiet vill nu att både Magdalena Andersson och Ulf Kristersson presenterar varsitt totalpaket för hur de vill styra Sverige. Vi vill ha förslagen nästa fredag. – För det första: Vilken politik vill ni genomföra för Sverige? För det andra: Hur ska ni genomföra den politiken och hur ska ni begränsa ytterkanternas inflytande? C-kännare säger till Expressen att partiet har ett drömläge och att det troligen är det sakpolitiska innehållet som avgör om vi får en regering som lutar åt höger eller vänster. Vänsterpartiets vice partiledare Ida Gabrielsson skriver på plattformen X att ”C har fått ett erbjudande om att regera på SD-mandat”. ”Att SD inte har ett officiellt avtal eller några officiella krav gör förstås ingen skillnad i realiteten. Utan SD-rösterna faller Kristerssons propositioner och hela budget. Så kan ingen regera och därför kan en sådan regering enbart överleva genom att säkra SD-stödet och ge SD inflytande.” Varför Thand Ringqvist bett Kristersson ”garantera” att SD inte ska få inflytande ”när hon vet att det inte går är bara märkligt”, skriver Gabrielsson vidare. S, MP, och V har 151 mandat i riksdagen. M, KD, L och C skulle bara ha 136. SD skulle, med 62 mandat, vara vågmästare när S, MP och V går fram med gemensamma förslag.

Man har bland annat gjort ett försök att reglera cykeltrafiken i kommunen under parollen ”ansvarsfull cyklist”, en kampanj som består av tio förhållningsregler för cyklister. Paula Llobret, ansvarig för innovation och turism förklarar draget i ett pressmeddelande. – Vi vill att Valencia ska förbli en stad där turisternas möjligheter att ta sig fram är förenliga med vardagslivet för dem som bor här. En svensexa eller möhippa kan snart komma att bötfällas med 16 500 kronor – om den genomförs under vissa tider och uppfyller kraven för vad staden anser ”stör den allmänna ordningen”, rapporterar Lavanguardia. Att ha ett föremål som föreställer ett könsorgan eller en sexdocka på allmän plats kan kosta över 8 000 kronor i böter.
